_doc: Focused PharmaOrb MVP RAG seed list. This is the exact 10-drug set used to prove cited Ask, evidence briefs, drug workspaces, and watchlists before expanding to top-300 coverage.

pubmed_query_families.name: reviews_meta_analyses
pubmed_query_families.query_template: "{drug}" AND (systematic review OR meta-analysis OR review)

pubmed_query_families.name: randomized_trials
pubmed_query_families.query_template: "{drug}" AND (randomized controlled trial OR clinical trial)

pubmed_query_families.name: recent_safety
pubmed_query_families.query_template: "{drug}" AND (safety OR adverse effects OR adverse reactions) AND 2020:3000[pdat]
